三大核心业务。随着产业数字化的加快，为适应更多应用场景让呈现更为多样化，乐动也将迎接智能时代“科技与产业变革”的新挑战，为大家带来更多惊喜与可能！

针对开发者全面开放，提供全新解决方案

现针对广大开发者全面开放，提供全新解决方案，
为行业带来新模式和新的开源思路。

sources.title: D100 LiDAR Kit
sources.quote: ## 1. D100 LiDAR Kit ### 1.1. Components - Triangulation LDROBOT LiDAR LD14 - CP2102 Adapter Panel and Connecting Line - LiDAR LD14 Datasheet and Development Manual ### 1.2. Features - Good performance, low cost and highly cost effective - 360° scanning for ranging - Small ranging error, good ranging stability and high precision - Broad scope of ranging: 0.15 - 8m - Low power consumption, small size, stable performance and sound endurance. - Abundant available data and technical support ### 1.3. Application field - Mapping, navigation and obstacle avoidance of mobile robot SALM - ROS education robot, Maker project - Robot cleaner
